summary: safeGit now catches git failures and returns a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr instead of returning the stdout string and throwing. The change also exports the GitResult type from the core package.

findings.title: Callers still treat the safeGit result as a string
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object, but neither caller was updated. currentBranch calls name.trim() in packages/cli/src/branch.ts:7, and changedFiles calls out.split() in packages/cli/src/status.ts:6.
findings.consequence: changedFiles throws a TypeError on every call. currentBranch catches its own TypeError and always returns null, even inside a repository.
findings.fix: Update both callers to read result.stdout and check result.code. currentBranch should return null when code is nonzero.

findings.title: No test covers the new safeGit failure path
findings.problem: safeGit now catches git failures and maps them to a code, but no test file exists in the repository. Nothing checks the success shape or the failure shape.
findings.consequence: Broken callers and wrong exit-code mapping can ship without any test failing.
findings.fix: Add tests for safeGit covering a successful command and a failing command. Also add tests for currentBranch and changedFiles.
